findings.body: The branch adds planning records but no driver implementation. In the readable source, `src/forge/codex_turn.py:131-134` catches every `JsonRpcError`, emits the fresh-start reason, and immediately starts another conversation. Thus an "already has an active writer" error still loses conversation continuity without stopping matching recorded processes, restarting the app-server, or retrying once. Implement the required recovery in the driver while preserving other resume errors' behavior.
findings.title: Not done: 3. Recover from an active-writer resume error before starting fresh

findings.body: The required test file is absent from both the supplied change and the readable checkout. Existing fallback coverage at `tests/test_codex_resume.py:247-271` exercises a missing conversation and expects a single resume attempt; it does not test active-writer recovery. Add executable coverage for successful recovery, exactly one retry followed by an explained fresh start on failure, unchanged handling of other errors, and the required process-identity and item-lock safeguards.
